surah.personality_title: Surah Al-Qiyamah (The Cosmic Resurrection, The Self-Accusing Soul, The Beatific Vision & The Seminal Clot)
surah.personality_summary: Autonomous Qur'anic surah possessing a distinctive theological axis, spiritual atmosphere, and structural cadence.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Qiyaama (The Resurrection) is the 75th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 40 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ لَا أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم لا اقسم بيوم القيامة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the Day of Resurrection

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and by the self-reproaching soul

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does man think We shall not put his bones back together

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بَلَىٰ قَادِرِينَ عَلَىٰ أَنْ نُسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بلى قادرين على ان نسوي بنانه
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: In fact, We can reshape his very fingertips

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But man desires to continue in sin
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he says, ‘So, when will this Day of Resurrection be?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So when vision is dazzled
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When eyes are dazzled

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the moon darkens
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the moon eclipsed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the sun and the moon are joined
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the sun and the moon are brought together

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on that Day man will say, ‘Where can I escape?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! There is no refuge
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Truly, there is no refuge

ayahs.translation_saheeh: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they will all return to your Lord on that Day

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يُنَبَّأُ الْإِنْسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ينبا الانسان يومئذ بما قدم واخر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day, man will be told what he put first and what he put last

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Truly, man is a clear witness against himself

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Even if he presents his excuses
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: despite all the excuses he may put forward

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لا تحرك به لسانك لتعجل به
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], do not rush your tongue in an attempt to hasten [your memorization of] the Revelation

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall make sure of its safe collection and recitation

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When We have recited it, repeat the recitation

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and We shall make it clear

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! But you love the immediate
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Truly you [people] love this fleeting world

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And leave the Hereafter
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and neglect the life to come

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On that Day there will be radiant faces

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Looking at their Lord
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: looking towards their Lord

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and on that Day there will be the sad and despairing faces

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: of those who realize that a great calamity is about to befall them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Truly, when the soul reaches the collarbone

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when it is said, ‘Could any charm-healer save him now?’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when he knows it is the final parting

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the leg is wound about the leg
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when his legs are brought together

ayahs.translation_saheeh: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on that day he will be driven towards your Lord

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He neither believed nor prayed

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But [instead], he denied and turned away
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but denied the truth and turned away

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: walking back to his people with a conceited swagger

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Woe to you, and woe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Closer and closer it comes to you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then woe to you, and woe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Closer and closer still

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Does man think that he will be left neglected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does man think he will be left alone

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةࣰ مِّن مَّنِيࣲّ يُمۡنَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِنْ مَنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الم يك نطفة من مني يمنى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Was he not just a drop of spilt-out sperm

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: which became a clinging form, which God shaped in due proportion

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And made of him two mates, the male and the female
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: fashioning from it the two sexes, male and female

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَنْ يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اليس ذلك بقادر على ان يحيي الموتى
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does He who can do this not have the power to bring the dead back to life
